name: Verdurous-Voe
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a subterranean ocean, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Instruments disagree about the temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
